name: alex-skills
description: A collection of agent skills for coding work, packaged as small single-purpose Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: conventional-commits
plugins.description: Writes git commit messages and pull request titles that follow the Conventional Commits specification, derived from the actual staged diff

plugins.name: frontend-developer
plugins.description: Builds Next.js App Router frontends in TypeScript with the structure and conventions of the next-learn dashboard example: server-first data fetching against a separate backend API, Server Actions with Zod validation, mandatory tests and linting

plugins.name: backend-developer
plugins.description: Builds Kotlin Spring Boot backends with a fixed package layout, RFC 9457 ProblemDetail error handling, JPA with Flyway migrations, Auth0 JWT validation, and mandatory ktlint, integration tests and 90% coverage gates
